remarks: Tucked up near the top of the village sits this home lovingly rehabilitated by the current owner.  Their downsizing means you reap the benefits of the rehabilitation of the house and property that has been done over the years! Enter through the wrap-around porch into the living room which is bright and airy with a vintage tin ceiling and large window that opens wide to allow the breeze to blow through the house.  Easy-care luxury vinyl plank floors throughout most of the house are handsome and give continuity.  The kitchen has a large window pouring in light and looks out over the gorgeous backyard; with new countertops and modern fixtures the kitchen is a joy to cook in.  The dining area flows into the morning room on the back of the house which is full of light from the large French doors and cozy with a wood burning fireplace.  The primary bedroom is tucked away off the morning room with an ensuite; the two additional bedrooms are located at the front of the house giving the primary bedroom complete privacy from noise or guests.  The second bathroom is off the hall near the two front bedrooms.  The basement has a laundry area and room for storage.  The 2-story barn has a workbench and second story for storage, and the cute outbuilding is water and critter tight and can be used for storage or.... waiting for you to create a pool house or playhouse.   The best for last... the large back deck off the morning room has been newly reinforced and has all new floorboards, perfect for entertaining.  Gorgeous views of the Catholic Church steeples as well as North Hill, Madison Hill, and Rauber Hill; always beautiful no matter the season.  With a privacy fence on both sides of the large backyard.  YOUR SANCTUARY AWAITS!
